The pilot neglects the effect of the wind and directs his plane due north and 2 hours later finds himself 300 km due north-east of city B. The wind velocity is (a) 150 km/hr at 45° N of E (b) 106 km/hr at 45° N of E (c) 150 km/hr at 45° N of W (d) 106 km/hr at 45° N of W

correct_answer: a 150 km/hr at 45° N of E
